_meta.title: CEC Power Content Labels: PG&E Base Plan, SVCE GreenStart / GreenPrime, California utility average

units.ghg_kg_per_mwh: kg CO2e per MWh (= lb x 0.45359237)

notes: 2024 is the latest year posted on the CEC Power Content Label page as retrieved 2026-10-24 (links run 2016..2024).
Label footnote: 'GHG intensity figures exclude biogenic CO2 and emissions from geothermal sources and grandfathered imports of firmed-and-shaped energy.'
Label footnote: 'Unspecified power is electricity purchased from a genericized pool on the open market.'
Label footnote: the label 'does not reflect compliance with the Renewables Portfolio Standard (RPS)'; unbundled RECs do not count in the mix or GHG intensity.
Percentages are whole numbers as printed, so a column can add to 99 or 101.
This is the supplier's annual portfolio claim. It does not identify the plant physically serving a home, and it is not an hourly figure.

pge_base.label: PG&E Base Plan
pge_base.source: 2024 Power Content Label, Pacific Gas and Electric Company (California Energy Commission, Power Source Disclosure Program)
pge_base.note: Base Plan column: GHG 16 lb CO2e/MWh; RPS Eligible Renewables 23%, Biomass & Biogas 3%, Geothermal 0%, Eligible Hydroelectric 1%, Solar 14%, Wind 4%, Large Hydroelectric 12%, Nuclear 63%, Natural Gas 2%, Coal & Petroleum 0%, Unspecified 0%; retail sales covered by retired unbundled RECs 7%.

svce_greenstart.label: SVCE GreenStart
svce_greenstart.source: 2024 Power Content Label, Silicon Valley Clean Energy (California Energy Commission, Power Source Disclosure Program)
svce_greenstart.note: Green Start column: GHG 202 lb CO2e/MWh; RPS Eligible 43%, Biomass & Biogas 3%, Geothermal 11%, Eligible Hydro 0%, Solar 21%, Wind 8%, Large Hydro 36%, Nuclear 0%, Natural Gas 0%, Coal & Petroleum 0%, Unspecified (primarily fossil fuels) 21%.

svce_greenprime.label: SVCE GreenPrime
svce_greenprime.source: 2024 Power Content Label, Silicon Valley Clean Energy (California Energy Commission, Power Source Disclosure Program)
svce_greenprime.note: Green Prime column: GHG 0 lb CO2e/MWh; RPS Eligible 100% (Solar 50%, Wind 50%).

svce_greenprime_direct.label: SVCE GreenPrime Direct
svce_greenprime_direct.source: 2024 Power Content Label, Silicon Valley Clean Energy (California Energy Commission, Power Source Disclosure Program)
svce_greenprime_direct.note: Green Prime Direct column: GHG 189 lb CO2e/MWh; Wind 48%, Large Hydro 32%, Unspecified 20%.

ca_utility_average.label: California utility average (2024)
ca_utility_average.source: 2024 Power Content Label, California Energy Commission (California Energy Commission, Power Source Disclosure Program)
ca_utility_average.note: 'CA Utility Average' column printed on every 2024 label (same on the PG&E and SVCE labels): GHG 359 lb CO2e/MWh; RPS 45%, Biomass & Biogas 2%, Geothermal 5%, Eligible Hydro 2%, Solar 23%, Wind 14%, Large Hydro 10%, Nuclear 11%, Natural Gas 10%, Coal & Petroleum 2%, Unspecified 22%.
